info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Auto Insurance Quotes Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Auto Insurance Quotes API allows users to remove or cancel existing auto insurance quotes efficiently. This endpoint is essential for policyholders who wish to withdraw from previously initiated quotes, ensuring their preferences are respected and updated in real-time. Typical consumers include insurance agents, customer support teams, and end-users interacting with auto insurance platforms. By facilitating the cancellation of quotes, this API supports streamlined customer service operations and enhances the overall user experience.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specific quote by its ID. Once a quote is canceled, it cannot be reinstated. Ensure that the quote ID is valid before attempting to cancel.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a quote. This operation allows clients to submit a cancellation request for a specific quote identified by its unique identifier. The body must adhere to the specified schema requirements.

206.description: Partial content returned; some functionality is still processing.

DeleteAutoInsuranceQuotesCancelRequest.description: A JSON string representing a request body for the DELETE operation related to cancelling quotes.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result pertaining to the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteAutoInsuranceQuotesCancelResponse_.description: Response schema for the cancellation operation DELETE request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.
